authority.next_executed_outcome: EMBER-02 first sufficiently pretrained clean-genesis 3B Ember

rule: Extends v0-pretrain-config.json with multimodal locks. All v0 fields carry forward unchanged. DO NOT modify v0-pretrain-config.json (frozen at v3). This config is the target for ember-multimodal-v0 training.

lock1_reserved_vocab_band.rule: Reserved band ids 0-7 are assigned within the frozen tokenizer (tokenizer-freeze-20260611T154111Z.json, vocab_size=32000). Model vocab = 32000 (no extension; delimiters <boi>=1/<eoi>=2 are INSIDE the base tokenizer vocab). Trainers use boi=1 as DELIM_START and eoi=2 as DELIM_END.

lock2_inputs_embeds.description: forward() accepts inputs_embeds; soft tokens (VisionEmbedder output) overwrite embed_tokens rows at placeholder-token positions before the decoder stack
lock2_inputs_embeds.splice_rule: positions where input_ids == IMAGE_START..IMAGE_END are overwritten with VisionEmbedder output; the rest use standard embed_tokens lookup

lock3_bidirectional_spans.description: attention mask constructor accepts span boundaries; marks image-token spans as bidirectional (full attention within span), rest stays causal
lock3_bidirectional_spans.rule: text-only v0 passes empty span set -> pure causal, unchanged. Multimodal passes span [(IMAGE_START_pos, IMAGE_END_pos)] per image.

lock4_rope_2d.description: head_dim=64 (1024 hidden / 16 heads); 64 % 4 == 0 verified. 2D x/y RoPE split: first 32 dims = x position, last 32 dims = y position. Enables image 2D-RoPE for spatial tokens.

qk_norm.description: QK-norm on attention queries and keys (cheap, unretrofittable per spec-sec-I). Applied from step 0.
qk_norm.component_status: add to LlamaConfig or custom attention class (eng-36)

vision_embedder.architecture: Linear(6912, 1024) + LayerNorm + factorized X/Y position lookups
vision_embedder.style: Fuyu-style continuous soft tokens, NOT discrete codes
vision_embedder.note: ~7M params; 48x48px patch -> 48*48*3=6912-float vector -> one matmul into model width 1024

audio_embedder.description: raw 16kHz 40ms -> one linear projection. Scope v0 to image-text first.

multimodal_data.format: encoder-free 48x48px-patch; image spans delimited by reserved band ids 1/2 (boi/eoi inside base tokenizer vocab)
multimodal_data.shard_format: uint16 packed shards, compatible with PackedShardLoader in scripts/timeshare_pretrain.py
multimodal_data.rule: B-MULTI-1 corpus must exist and pass selftest before multimodal training can dispatch

runner_extension.selftest_rule: t1_multimodal_selftest.py must exit 0 on CPU (<30s) before any GPU dispatch
